code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and lymphopenia, with monocytosis and basophilia. There is microcytosis with normal hemoglobin, elevated ferritin, and a slightly increased INR. Inflammatory markers (CRP, procalcitonin) are not significantly elevated. Liver and renal function are normal. Findings suggest possible underlying infection or inflammatory process, with some features compatible with viral infection or bone marrow suppression. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
